primary.title: Gold Edges Lower as Traders Weigh Middle East Signals, Fed Rate Path
primary.summary: Gold dipped as a flareup in Middle East hostilities raised inflation risks, even as the Federal Reserve is still expected to keep interest rates steady in the near term.

related.title: Gold Swings as Traders Assess Fed Rate Path Amid Mideast Worries
related.summary: Gold fluctuated as traders assessed the outlook for the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate path on the back of potential renewed hositilities in the Middle East.
